$$\begin{array}{l}

\mathrm{M} \equiv(\alpha, \beta) \\
\alpha=\frac{3 \cos \phi+4 \cos \phi}{2}=\frac{7}{2} \cos \phi \\

options.D:

t_{n}=c\left\{n^{2}-(n-1)^{2}\right\} \\
=c(2 n-1) \\
\Rightarrow t_{n}^{2}=c^{2}\left(4 n^{2}-4 n+1\right) \\

=\frac{c^{2} n}{6}\{4(n+1)(2 n+1)-12(n+1)+6\} \\

A solid sphere of radius R has a charge Q distributed in its volume with a charge density $\rho=\mathrm{kr}^{\mathrm{a}}$, where k and a are constants and r is the distance from its centre. If the electric field at r=R/2 is 1/8 times that at r= R, find the value of a.
IITJEE2009-Paper 2-CMP-23

steps:
2
$$\begin{array}{l}
\rho=k r^{a} \\
E\left(r=\frac{R}{2}\right)=\frac{1}{8} E(r=R) \\
\frac{q_{\text {enclosed }}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}(R / 2)^{2}}=\frac{1}{8} \frac{Q}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R^{2}} \\
32 q_{\text {enclosed }}=Q \\
q_{\text {enclosed }}=\int_{0}^{R / 2} k r^{a} 4 \pi r^{2} d r=\frac{4 \pi k}{(a+3)}\left(\frac{R}{2}\right)^{(a+3)} \\
Q=\frac{4 \pi k}{(a+3)} R^{(a+3)} \\
\frac{Q}{q_{\text {enclosed }}}=2^{a+3} \\
2^{a+3}=32 \\
a=2
\end{array}$$
